title: Lower the actual primitive wrapper and protected binary contexts to finite-state tape control
body:
## Exact result and novelty
A seven-symbol finite-state graph implements the actual Controller.primitive wrapper with protected binary context, dirty scratch retirement, head restoration and success cleanup. For N table rows, L ports and K work ports, at most 52N+3L+18K+9 states; its serialized clock C=A+U counts complete raw actions. This extends the narrower #6999 control proof.

## Reproduction and independent checks
28 protocol and 372 arithmetic cases, six controls and separate target-only review. Replay: python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/contextual-primitive-microcontrol

## Limitations and bound status
No new kappa. All five selected assumptions, provider kernels, production descriptors, and tariff conversion remain open. Selected conditional kappa remains 0.00363005817; the five framework assumptions remain.

## Attribution
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit #6999 and all retained native/Controller predecessors.
